issue.title: Album notes — every record collection hangs under the area it serves
issue.description: Every record note reaches an area of responsibility. Each record collection (eat, podcasts, tv, movies) becomes an album note: `type: "[[album]]"` under its owner area, holding its record schema in frontmatter instead of `config.yml`, de-zorged, and showing a generated, grouped `[!records]` index. Every owner area or project shows a beautiful generated `## Albums` catalog. Records become `type: "[[record]]"` children of their album. Schema and data version together in the vault, a broken album fails alone, and glossary terms for album note and record note are published.
